note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of the straight front photo (44 mm case, listing; strap 20.91 mm and lug-to-lug 52.5 mm measured against 22 mm and 50 mm listed). Heights before the house depth scale (12 mm thick listing). Dial print, Roman numerals, minute-track flange and the strap leather come from one photo map.

case.note: (r, z): polished flank rounding into the wide sloped polished bezel (18.14-22 mm in the photo); inner lip covers the flange edge

lobe.note: crown-side lobe between the pushers, flat top just under the flank top

dial.note: flat dial to the flange's inner edge, then the minute-track flange as a cone up to the bezel lip

strap.note: House curl (SUR419P1): bend at the lug tips (26.25 mm), 7 mm radius, end_y = tip + 2.2 x radius

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass

lume.note: white lume inserts on the hour and minute hands (photo)
